---
title: "Our Liverpool"
---

```{python}
#| output: asis
import json
from pathlib import Path

routes = json.loads(Path("data/routes.geojson").read_text())
photos = json.loads(Path("data/photos.geojson").read_text())
n = len(routes["features"])
km = sum(f["properties"]["km"] for f in routes["features"])
print(f'<div class="stats"><b>{n}</b> of us · <b>{km:,.0f} km</b> of routes · '
      f'<b>{len(photos["features"])}</b> photos. Hover over a route to see whose it is; '
      f'click a photo to open it.</div>')
print(f'<script>window.GDSL_ROUTES = {json.dumps(routes)}; window.GDSL_PHOTOS = {json.dumps(photos)};</script>')
```

<div class="map-tools">
<button id="v-city" class="on">Liverpool</button>
<button id="v-all">Everyone (incl. long commutes)</button>
<button id="v-photos">Photos only</button>
<button id="v-tour">▶ Photo tour</button>
</div>

<div class="map-wrap">
<div id="map"></div>
<div class="people" id="people"></div>
</div>

<link rel="stylesheet" href="assets/leaflet/leaflet.css">
<script src="assets/leaflet/leaflet.js"></script>
<script>
(function () {
  // colours: GDSL blues/teals first, then a wider categorical set
  const palette = ["#3f6fae","#e4572e","#2a9d8f","#9c4dcc","#f2a541","#d62d6b","#5fa8bf","#6a994e",
                   "#c1440e","#1d3557","#b5838d","#ef476f","#118ab2","#8d6e1f","#7b2cbf","#06a77d",
                   "#e76f51","#4361ee","#bc4749","#264653","#ff8fab","#588157"];
  const CITY = L.latLngBounds([53.378, -3.005], [53.428, -2.925]);

  const map = L.map("map", { zoomSnap: 0.25, scrollWheelZoom: true, maxZoom: 16 });
  // Esri World Light Gray Canvas: grey basemap, no API key needed
  const esri = "https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/Canvas/";
  L.tileLayer(esri + "World_Light_Gray_Base/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}", {
    attribution: 'Tiles &copy; Esri &mdash; Esri, HERE, Garmin, &copy; OpenStreetMap contributors',
    maxZoom: 16
  }).addTo(map);
  map.createPane("labels"); map.getPane("labels").style.zIndex = 450;
  map.getPane("labels").style.pointerEvents = "none";
  L.tileLayer(esri + "World_Light_Gray_Reference/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}", {
    pane: "labels", maxZoom: 16
  }).addTo(map);

  const routes = window.GDSL_ROUTES.features;
  const photos = window.GDSL_PHOTOS.features;
  const colourOf = {}, layerOf = {}, markerOf = {};
  routes.forEach((f, i) => { colourOf[f.properties.name] = palette[i % palette.length]; });
  const esc = s => String(s || "").replace(/[&<>"]/g, c => ({"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;"}[c]));

  const highlight = name => {
    const l = layerOf[name]; if (!l) return;
    l.setStyle({ weight: 10, opacity: 1 }); l.bringToFront();
  };
  const unhighlight = name => { const l = layerOf[name]; if (l) routeLayer.resetStyle(l); };

  // white casing underneath makes routes readable where they overlap
  const casing = L.geoJSON(window.GDSL_ROUTES, {
    style: { color: "#fff", weight: 8, opacity: 0.9, lineCap: "round", lineJoin: "round" },
    interactive: false
  }).addTo(map);

  const routeLayer = L.geoJSON(window.GDSL_ROUTES, {
    style: f => ({ color: colourOf[f.properties.name], weight: 5, opacity: 0.9, lineCap: "round", lineJoin: "round" }),
    onEachFeature: (f, layer) => {
      const p = f.properties;
      layerOf[p.name] = layer;
      layer.bindTooltip(`<b>${esc(p.name)}</b> · ${p.km} km`, { sticky: true, className: "route-label" });
      layer.on("mouseover", () => highlight(p.name));
      layer.on("mouseout",  () => unhighlight(p.name));
      layer.on("click", () => markerOf[p.name] ? markerOf[p.name].openPopup() : null);
    }
  }).addTo(map);

  const photoLayer = L.layerGroup().addTo(map);
  photos.forEach(f => {
    const p = f.properties, [lon, lat] = f.geometry.coordinates;
    const c = colourOf[p.name] || "#0e1e25";
    const m = L.marker([lat, lon], {
      riseOnHover: true,
      icon: L.divIcon({ className: "", iconSize: [46, 46], iconAnchor: [23, 23], popupAnchor: [0, -20],
        html: `<div class="thumb" style="--c:${c};background-image:url('${esc(p.thumb)}')"></div>` })
    });
    m.bindPopup(`<img src="${esc(p.img)}" alt="Photo from ${esc(p.name)}'s route">
      <div class="pname" style="color:${c}">${esc(p.name)}</div>${p.caption ? `<div class="pcap">${esc(p.caption)}</div>` : ""}`,
      { maxWidth: 360, autoPanPadding: [40, 40] });
    m.on("mouseover", () => highlight(p.name));
    m.on("mouseout",  () => unhighlight(p.name));
    m.on("popupopen", () => highlight(p.name));
    m.on("popupclose", () => unhighlight(p.name));
    markerOf[p.name] = m;
    photoLayer.addLayer(m);
  });

  // ---- views
  const btns = ["v-city", "v-all", "v-photos", "v-tour"].map(id => document.getElementById(id));
  const setOn = id => btns.forEach(b => b.classList.toggle("on", b.id === id));
  let touring = null;
  const stopTour = () => { if (touring) { clearTimeout(touring); touring = null; btns[3].textContent = "▶ Photo tour"; } };
  const showRoutes = on => [casing, routeLayer].forEach(l => on ? l.addTo(map) : map.removeLayer(l));

  const viewCity = () => { stopTour(); showRoutes(true); map.flyToBounds(CITY, { duration: 0.8 }); setOn("v-city"); };
  const viewAll  = () => { stopTour(); showRoutes(true); map.flyToBounds(routeLayer.getBounds(), { padding: [30, 30], duration: 0.8 }); setOn("v-all"); };
  const viewPhotos = () => {
    stopTour(); showRoutes(false); map.closePopup();
    const g = L.featureGroup(Object.values(markerOf));
    map.flyToBounds(g.getBounds(), { padding: [50, 50], duration: 0.8 }); setOn("v-photos");
  };
  const tour = () => {
    if (touring) { stopTour(); return; }
    showRoutes(true); setOn("v-tour"); btns[3].textContent = "■ Stop tour";
    const names = Object.keys(markerOf).sort();
    let i = 0;
    const step = () => {
      const name = names[i % names.length], m = markerOf[name];
      map.flyTo(m.getLatLng(), 15, { duration: 1.5 });
      setTimeout(() => m.openPopup(), 1600);
      i++; touring = setTimeout(step, 7000);
    };
    step();
  };
  btns[0].onclick = viewCity; btns[1].onclick = viewAll; btns[2].onclick = viewPhotos; btns[3].onclick = tour;
  map.fitBounds(CITY);

  // ---- people list
  const list = document.getElementById("people");
  routes.map(f => f.properties).sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name)).forEach(p => {
    const b = document.createElement("button");
    b.innerHTML = `<span class="sw" style="background:${colourOf[p.name]}"></span>${esc(p.name)}`
      + (markerOf[p.name] ? ' <span class="cam-s">📷</span>' : "") + `<span class="km">${p.km} km</span>`;
    b.onclick = () => {
      stopTour(); showRoutes(true);
      map.flyToBounds(layerOf[p.name].getBounds(), { padding: [60, 60], maxZoom: 16, duration: 0.8 });
      highlight(p.name);
      if (markerOf[p.name]) setTimeout(() => markerOf[p.name].openPopup(), 900);
      setTimeout(() => unhighlight(p.name), 3000);
    };
    b.onmouseenter = () => highlight(p.name);
    b.onmouseleave = () => unhighlight(p.name);
    list.appendChild(b);
  });
})();
</script>
